findings.issue: The sentence said Snap 'printed a quarter TechCrunch greeted with' the headline; the TechCrunch headline 'Snap finally did it, y'all' does not say what Snap did, so tying it to the quarter overreached the headline.
findings.resolution: Rephrased to 'the underdog drew TechCrunch's headline ...', quoting the headline without asserting its subject.

findings.issue: The first price trigger was a close back below the 38.91 USD gap-day close, which any ordinary down day would meet; not a meaningful invalidation.
findings.resolution: Replaced with an observable test tied to the card move: the first sessions handing back half of the 58.82% jump.

findings.issue: Chronology: the India 30% crypto tax had already served as a break test in the 2022-02-02 Solana item, and hack risk was the 2022-02-04 Bitcoin break; the item recycled cautions in the second consecutive crypto slot.
findings.resolution: Kept the CNBC hack line, replaced India with the newly published BBC report on the UN finding that stolen crypto funds North Korea's missile programme (n1413, stamped 2022-02-06); note updated.

findings.issue: 'being passed around as a jackpot' implied observed sharing activity beyond what the Moomoo headline shows.
findings.resolution: Changed to 'being pitched as a jackpot', which the Moomoo item's own title supports.

findings.issue: 'a profit beat' attributed to Pinterest, while the cited Reuters headline (n0703) says its results dazzled as the ad business booms, not a profit beat.
findings.resolution: Changed to 'an ad boom and user growth are different stories'.

findings.issue: Checked all 34 cited IDs against the 2022-02-07 feed (titles, sources, stamps all before 2022-02-07 00:00 UTC; company news within seven days, Fed baseline n2089 within 35 days), every number against the card (SNAP, META, PINS, NDX, 2Y, PTON, F, RIVN, BTC, MSTR, GBTC, RIOT), period identities (Meta Platforms/FB) and timing guardrails (payrolls used as known via n2073; no Caixin services PMI or Monday Asian trading). Peloton's surge is correctly placed after the 4 February close (+1.44%). Chronology vs 1-4 February: Snap, Peloton and Ford are new; MicroStrategy is a new leveraged-proxy angle on newly published evidence (n0945, n0947) after the 2022-02-04 Bitcoin item; Amazon correctly held back.

scope_limits: Headlines only (no article bodies); the card is the sole price source; the 2022-02-01 to 02-04 retail drafts and notes were read as editorial memory only. No later-date files were read.
